Asterix - The Mansions of the Gods.name: Asterix: The Mansions of the Gods
Asterix - The Mansions of the Gods.summary: By Toutatis! Play Asterix The Mansions of the Gods! Play as Asterix, Obelix and Dogmatix in their quest to save the forest. Prepare the magic potion so you can give the crazy Romans lots of smacks! Walk through the village, hunt wild boar, make the bard stop singing and prepare the final victory banquet!

Youkai Watch 3 - Sushi.name: Yo-Kai Watch 3: Sushi
Youkai Watch 3 - Sushi.summary: Third game of the main series of Yo-kai Watch video games. It was initially released in two versions, Sushi and Tempura. The player switches control between 2 characters, one in Japan and the other in the USA.
